title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.17 (versions follow prime numbers; 317 after 313): the open thread is the centre of the talk. What she just showed is what they speak of: when she answers with a line of a book, her theme becomes that book, just after it. If he brings no sharp word (outside the common half of her books: Razar's nitidez) that is not in what she just showed, and he asks, she answers about the thread by deduction, her way of 'who is', with the thread in the place of his words: no canned answer, oriented by the word of it that says most to her. If he does not ask, she goes on from where she is. Only a new sharp word sends her to look through all her books. Seen in a copy of her house with a test build that always answers: five questions in a row stayed in her author's diary. Stated: her half is measured on the book she reads now (one at a time), so a word very common in it may not pull her to a new topic; her wish to answer still decides when she stays silent. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.17: el hilo abierto es el centro de la charla. Prototipo de investigación.
